m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify the handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read the inherited global doctrine (references/global-crew.md, references/global-everyone.md), the project deltas docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the g2 handoff, and the writer's read seams (scripts/apply_episode_delta.py store_root/_require_store_layout, episodes/README.md, one real episode record). Verify the handoff is complete: task, intent, allowed scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format. Block and return if incomplete. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: doctrine + crew context + handoff + store read seams read; handoff complete

constraints: CREATE ONLY the two named files; COMMENT ONLY in apply_episode_delta.py

m1-capture-gate.title: Capture gate: match episodes by their `- run:` line
m1-capture-gate.imperative: TDD. Write tests/test_verify_episode_captured.py covering the capture legs first and observe them RED: a seeded temp store with an episode for the work id exits 0 and prints ids + count; an empty store exits 1; a store holding only other runs' episodes exits 1. Then write scripts/verify_episode_captured.py: CLI `<work-id> [--store-root PATH] [--phase feedback|archive]`, enumerating <store-root>/active/*.md and parsing ONLY the `<!-- episode-state: -->` header line and the `- run:` mechanical line. No ripeness, no apply-or-defer, no dormancy, no counters. Attest c1 (red observed), then advance for green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: capture-leg tests written and observed failing before the script existed — manual attest
capture legs green: seeded store passes, empty store fails, other-runs-only store fails

constraints: seed temp stores only, never episodes/

m2-refuse-missing-store.title: A missing active/ directory is refused, not answered
m2-refuse-missing-store.imperative: TDD. Add the refusal tests and observe them RED: a store root that does not exist, and a store root whose active/ is absent, both exit NON-ZERO with a message naming the missing path — never exit 0 'no episodes'. Then implement the refusal in the verifier, distinct from the ordinary no-match exit. Attest c1 (red observed), then advance for green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: refusal tests written and observed failing — manual attest
missing store root and missing active/ both refused with non-zero exit and a clear message

constraints: refusal exit code must be non-zero and distinguishable from the no-match exit

m3-archive-phase.title: --phase archive additionally requires the episode to be tracked by git
m3-archive-phase.imperative: TDD. Add tests and observe them RED: under --phase archive, a matched episode in a temp git repo that has been `git add`ed passes; the same episode untracked fails. Then implement the archive leg with `git ls-files --error-unmatch <path>` per matched episode. Attest c1 (red observed), then advance for green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: archive-phase tests written and observed failing — manual attest
archive phase passes for a tracked episode and fails for an untracked one

constraints: the archive leg must have BOTH a green and a red proof, not just a red one

m4-valve-sentinel.title: THE VALVE: prove no assertion statement text reaches stdout or stderr
m4-valve-sentinel.imperative: Seed a temp store where EVERY assertion statement is the literal SENTINEL-DO-NOT-LEAK-9f2a. Run the verifier capturing stdout AND stderr; assert the sentinel appears in neither. Give that test its own red proof: patch the verifier so it echoes the record body, run the SAME assertion path, and assert the sentinel IS then found. Also assert statically that the script never imports query_episodes. Attest c1 with the red-proof transcript, then advance for green.

postconditions.statement: red proof observed: with the leak patched in, the sentinel IS found — the leak test can fail — manual attest

constraints: a leak test that cannot fail is worth nothing — the red proof is mandatory

m5-store-root-comment.title: Name the installed-copy store_root() hazard in a comment, change nothing
m5-store-root-comment.imperative: Add a comment at scripts/apply_episode_delta.py store_root() naming the measured hazard: on an installed skill copy the parent-of-parent resolves to the skill install directory, not the project repo, so a caller without an explicit --store-root silently creates a store outside the repo while every gate reads green. State that callers on an installed copy must pass --store-root. Do NOT change store_root()'s semantics or its docstring ruling. Prove no behaviour changed by running the store's own suite.

postconditions.statement: comment added at store_root(); no behaviour change — the episode store suite still passes
